title: Ntenyi language
text: Ntenyi, also known as Northern Rengma Naga, is a Sino-Tibetan language of the Tibeto-Burman branch spoken primarily by the Rengma Naga people in the Kohima district of Nagaland, northeastern India, with approximately 13,000 speakers (as of 1997).
